data.body: Decision (operator): ship the snapshot-close-metadata ensure unit with its cost documented, then run `rebar store fsck --repair` once after the change merges. Dry run on a remote-less copy of the 300,866-commit tracker: the first sweep rebuilt the 12 stale SNAPSHOTs in 1,482.6 s under the write lock and made 12 commits; the second sweep took 21.5 s and made 0 commits (ok, no unconverged tickets). Of the first sweep, about 7.4 min was the per-ticket commit-map lookup; the remaining ~17 min is unprofiled. Unchecked: null commit shas in the rebuilt ledgers, and how long a blocked writer waits before failing. State: committed on branch fix-df72-stale-snapshot-close (rebased on origin/main 2fb6062bfe5); 7 new unit tests pass; make check passes; make verify running before the Gerrit push.
